definitions.short: Dan , one of the sons of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory; likewise a place in Palestine colonized by them
definitions.full: H1835. Dan דָּן proper name, masculine ( judge ) — 1 son of Jacob and Bilhah Gen 30:6 ; 35:25 ; Exod 1:4 ; Josh 19:47 ; Judg 18:29 ; 1Chr 2:2 . 2 the tribe of Dan , דָן מַטֵּה Exod 31:6 ; 35:34 ; 38:23 ; Lev 24:11 ; Num 1:39 ; 13:12 ; Josh 21:5 , 23 (all P); דָן בְּנֵי Gen 46:23 ; Num 1:38 ; 2:25 ; 7:66 ; 10:25 ; 26:42 ; 34:22 ; Josh 19:40 , 47 (twice in verse); 19:48 (all P) Judg 1:34 ; 18:2 , 16 , 22 , 23 , 25 , 26 , 30 ; דָן מַחֲנֵה Num 2:25 , 31 (P) — on Judg 13:25 ; 18:12 see מַחֲנֶה ; דָּן מִשְׁמְּחֹת Num 26:42 (P); דָּן alone in poetry Gen 49:16-17 , Deut 33:22 (twice in verse); Judg 5:17 , elsewhere Num 1:12 (P) Deut 27:13 ; 1Chr 27:22 ; 2Chr 2:13 ; Ezek 48:1-2 , 32 . 3 a city on northern frontier of Israel at one of the sources of the Jordan , originally לַיִשׁ Judg 18:29 (compare 18:7 ); = לֶשֶׁם Josh 19:47 ; captured by a colony of Danites; named Dan, and made a sacred place with rites of worship that lasted until the exile ( Judg 18:30 ); = Tell el Kâdî , Rob BR iii. 351, 358 Bd Pa1 265 . This place is frequently referred to: Gen 14:14 ; Deut 34:1 ; 1Kin 12:29-30 , 15:20 ; 2Kin 10:29 ; 2Chr 16:4 ; Jer 4:15 ; 8:16 ; Amos 8:14 ; read also וּבְדָן for וְכֵן 2Sam 20:18 ᵐ5 Ew We compare Dr; and see the phrase שֶׁבַע וְעַדבְּֿאֵר מִדָּן Judg 20:1 ; 1Sam 3:20 ; 2Sam 3:10 ; 17:11 ; 24:2 , 15 ; 1Kin 5:5 ; given by Chronicles וְעַדדָּֿן שֶׁבַע מִבְּאֵר 1Chr 21:2 ; 2Chr 30:5 . ( Ezek 27:19 see ודן .) Note. — יַעַן דָּ֫נָה 2Sam 24:6 . As no such place is known, the text is usually regarded as corrupt, and, ᵐ5 being uncertain, is variously changed: (1) יַעַר דָּ֫נָה to Dan in the wood , Thes after ᵑ9 silvestria.
